source: Frozen compact v1. Read the sealed same single-frame returns and six isolated-noun posterior sizes. No source training or target updates.
panels: All 1204 records of the preceding study, including 576 ordinary records from six directions and 168 natural relational records. Change-landmark: 50 pairs; opposite-side: 134 pairs; same-half opposite-side: 46 pairs. Read single sentences independently.
mechanism: Each distinct measured component in the eight nested return partitions is an object hypothesis available for both roles. A latent tree cut stops according to the best metric size likelihood among frozen nouns; otherwise recurse. Conditioning on two named endpoints and the absence of any nearer eligible referent sums all shared cuts. Use expected point-support Jaccard to recover an output component. Both object anchors and shape completions are derived directly from returns.
geometry: PCA of foreground points; raw horizontal midrange, observed top and lower of observed minimum and terrain under center. Completion expands physical dimensions to at least the median noun regression, holding the sensor-facing side of each horizontal slab and terrain bottom fixed. v1 retains previously measured local-ground face control for comparison.
decision: To support a new role mechanism, gain in correct physical switches when only the reference changes and in reference identity over independent and mismatched controls, with no opposing task loss. Geometry must rescue correctly identified physical subjects over all source proposals; report all harms and a matched fixed-geometry control. No GT before emission, no tuning on endpoints, no FINAL.
selection: Uniform identity prior times geometric mean of normalized overlapping frozen phrase votes, with a uniform one-vote prior so nodes outside the old proposal pool remain selectable. All physical candidates remain in the denominator.
uncertainty: Report both IoU/seed-ownership rules, unknowns retained, direction totals and uncertainty clustered by recording. Pre-exposed development recordings only.
